{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorlift couch''' or '''repulsor couch'''<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> was an anti-gravity device similar to a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|power chair]] but designed for more users.<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

[[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were known to favor repulsorlift couches to accommodate their large sizes.<ref name="KT" />
